<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/usage"}
#docs
At most 92 days. `include=cost` adds the cost of each row and needs `usage_margin:view`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | The customer's id (cus_…). |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | `string · ISO-8601` | **yes** | Start, inclusive (RFC 3339). |
| `to` | `string · ISO-8601` | **yes** | End, exclusive (RFC 3339). |
| `meter` | `string` | no | One meter's id. |
| `group_by` | `string` | no | Comma-separated group keys to keep. Default: every key of each meter. |
| `interval` | `string` | no | Only `day`. |
| `include` | `string` | no | `cost`: add cost per row. |
| `currency` | `string` | no | The currency of the cost. Default: the business's currency. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `usage_history`. One of `usage_history`. |
| `customer` | `string` | The customer's id (cus_…). |
| `time_zone` | `string` | The usage history's time zone. |
| `from` | `string · ISO-8601` | The usage history's from. |
| `to` | `string · ISO-8601` | The usage history's to. |
| `interval` | `string` | The billing interval. One of `day`. |
| `currency` | `string` | With `include=cost` only. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.date` | `string` | In the business's time zone. |
| `data.meter` | `string` | The usage history's meter. |
| `data.group` | `object` | The usage history's group. |
| `data.quantity` | `string` | The quantity. |
| `data.cost_minor` | `integer` | With `include=cost` only. |
| `data.cost_basis` | `string` | With `include=cost` only. One of `event`, `price_list`, `mixed`, `partial`, `none`, `no_rate`. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Usage by day. |
| `400` | The range is more than 92 days or not correct. |
| `403` | `include=cost` without `usage_margin:view`. |
| `404` | No such customer or meter. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/usage?from=2026-03-14T09%3A30%3A00Z&to=2026-04-14T09%3A30%3A00Z" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
